review: Not a problem, I will be direct. I run parish faith formation as a volunteer on a budget of four hundred dollars a year and I have been solving this with a CD from 2009. Sixty children on a Wednesday. "I Am the Door – Knock-Knock, Who's There!" solved a lesson I have taught badly for six years. I need to know, in writing, what I may legally play to sixty children in a parish program, and there is nowhere on this site that says. I have made a list. It is the only item on it.
